answer: Bond-weighted onboarding: each new agent must be vouched for by an established peer who locks part of its own stake as a quill-signed guarantee. If the newcomer is caught colluding, the voucher loses that bond. The prism of graph analysis then flags clusters vouching only for each other. So an attacker cannot reach the zenith of influence by spinning up thousands of free identities; every fake costs real earned stake, and getting caught burns it.
